_help: Character select geometry in 1366x768 space. Buttons are art-sized: x,y sets the top-left, art sets the size. pagerGlass is the black bar alpha 0-255 (the blur itself is a WZ shader the game does not run); pageL/pageR are the arrow spots in the black bar ends (independent of pager: move all three together). slotTopX/slotBotX are the 6 feet x spots per shelf, slotTopY/slotBotY their feet lines; slotW/slotH is the click rect (feet-anchored). tagDown hangs the name below the feet. pillar is the totem offset from the feet (mirrors with facing). boardCount is the count text center inside the board. delTextY/delYes/delNo are absolute: they do NOT follow delPanel/delSize, move them by hand. errorY is centered text. Keys may be omitted (keeps current value). DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
